other_conditions: Applicant must be a legal nominee or dependent of the deceased worker
Deceased worker must have been a resident of the Union Territory of Andaman & Nicobar Islands
Deceased worker must have been engaged in building or other construction work
Financial assistance is provided for natural death of registered workers
Accidental death of registered workers qualifies for a higher benefit amount
Accidental death of non‑registered construction workers qualifies for a reduced benefit, subject to a Tehsildar certificate
benefits_summary: Provides ₹1,00,000 for natural death, ₹2,00,000 for accidental death of registered workers, and ₹50,000 for accidental death of non‑registered construction workers.
documents_required: Certificate from the Tehsildar stating the deceased was a construction worker
